I understand that team balance is a difficult thing to get right, but I just played multiple games where one team was players in levels 10-25 (or pretty close) and the other was all players in 25-40. That is pretty bad. Yes I know that there are no unlocks that make a difference at each level, but levels correlate to time played and that generally means better players, more knowledge of maps, etc. There was one game where I was that highest ranking player on my team (level 13 at the time) and the other team had not a single player under 20. In each of those games we were dominated by the higher ranked team.

It gives players with less map knowledge incentive to learn. If you can't enjoy the game while loosing it's not a very fun game. What is needed when games have a mismatch problem is to shuffle the teams often so people don't have the experience of 1 hour of just loosing.
